titulo: Carrion emerges as a key force shaping ecosystems, disease and human evolution
cuerpo: What happens after death? An international study led by the University of Granada (UGR), involving Ana Mateos and Jesús Rodríguez, researchers at the Centro Nacional de Investigación sobre la Evolución Humana (CENIEH), argues that this question, long overlooked by ecology, can help us understand a wide range of processes and offer new perspectives across different disciplines.
